mapper.select: SELECT b.*, c.category_name FROM budget b LEFT JOIN finance_category c ON b.category_id = c.id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND b.cycle_value = #{cycleValue} ORDER BY b.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO budget (user_id, category_id, cycle_type, cycle_value, budget_amount, used_amount, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{categoryId}, #{cycleType}, #{cycleValue}, #{budgetAmount}, 0, NOW(), NOW())
